children: According to Wallstreetcn, U.S. President Donald Trump returned to the White House from Camp David in Maryland on the evening of September 19 U.S. Eastern Time, shortening his planned weekend trip by one day, with the exact reason unclear. Axios and other media reported the early return, while a CNN program said Trump had reviewed and assessed options for strikes against Yemen's Houthi forces at Camp David.

title: U.S. President Donald Trump Returns to the White House Early From Camp David
